environment: Local native macOS ARM64, Go 1.27.2, NATS Server 2.15.0
finding: The test fixture discarded its broker owner before joining the original Wait. An uncertain shutdown could therefore lose cleanup ownership and allow another broker start.
reviewedRepair: The fixture retains both the concrete command and its original completion channel until Wait joins. An uncertain shutdown blocks restart. Signal, kill and unsuccessful-exit failures remain visible. The original one-second shutdown and one-second forced-join bounds are unchanged.
limits: Only two anchored tests ran. No Linux, AMD64, installed-CLI, Docker or complete phase acceptance is established.
The uncertain kill/wait timeout branch was reviewed in source, not exercised by the successful runs.
The earlier failed fixture lost its broker log. That limitation remains recorded in /tmp/agentmux-broker-recovery.XPsX9R/result.json.
Private broker artifacts contain disposable credentials and must not be published.
Final exact-candidate source registration, affected suites and phase review remain required.
